create_lora_memory_pool: create a LoRAMemoryPool instance to manage GPU memory for LoRA adapter weights across TP ranks
test_lora_support: test whether a LoRAConfig can be supported by the memory pool given rank and target module constraints
prepare_lora_batch: prepare a batch of LoRA adapters by loading weights into memory buffers with eviction when full
load_lora_weight_to_buffer: load LoRA adapter weights into pre-allocated GPU buffers with TP sharding and MoE expert handling
get_lora_a_shape: get the tensor shape for LoRA A weights, returning 3D for standard or 4D for MoE modules
